title: Ridon’s tip to defense: Don’t remove Poa, he’s the best you have

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — It will be a loss for Vice President Sara Duterte if lawyer Michael Poa will be the one sacrificed after an internal squabble, as he is the most capable and kindest member of the defense panel, Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon said on Wednesday. Ridon, a member of the public prosecution team, was asked in a press brifing if he feels Poa is out of place in the defense panel as they always hold Poa in high regard compared to other Duterte lawyers. “Well siya na nga ‘yong pinaka-magaling do’n eh, siya na ‘yong pinaka-mabait do’n.
